an5.39:1.1: “Bhikkhus, considering five prospects, mother and father wish for a son to be born in their family.
an5.39:1.3: (1) ‘Having been supported by us, he will support us.
an5.39:1.4: (2) Or he will do work for us.
an5.39:1.5: (3) Our family lineage will be extended.
an5.39:1.7: (5) or else, when we have passed on, he will give an offering on our behalf.’
an5.39:1.8: Considering these five prospects, mother and father wish for a son to be born in their family.”
an5.39:2.2: wise people wish for a son.
an5.39:2.3: “Supported by us, he will support us,
an5.39:2.4: or he will do work for us.
an5.39:3.1: The family lineage will be extended,
an5.39:3.3: or else, when we have passed on,
an5.39:3.4: he will make an offering on our behalf.”
an5.39:4.2: wise people wish for a son.
an5.39:5.2: recalling how they helped one in the past;
an5.39:5.3: they do what is necessary for them
an5.39:5.4: as they did for oneself in the past.
an5.39:6.1: Following their advice, nurturing those who brought him up,
an5.39:6.4: this son is worthy of praise.
